newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BETTS SPURS DURHAM WITH FIVE-WICKET BURST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BETTS SPURS DURHAM WITH FIVE-WICKET BURST.

text.p: Durham pace bowler Melvyn Betts took five for five in six overs against Kent on Friday to put his side on course for their first county championship win for 24 matches.

On a rain-sodden day that meant little play was possible in most county games, Betts' career-best figures of seven for 29 saw the championship leaders slump from 138 for four overnight to 167 all out in their first innings at Darlington.
But Betts, 22, had to share some of the limelight with Kent seamer Matthew Fleming who took four for 34 to add to his first innings tally of five for 55.
Durham ended the third day on 183 for eight, a lead of 267.
